blocks.text: Cooler versus dry pick notes, March 21

This is the working cut for PCF-MTG-2024-029 on March 21, 2024. Drew Phelps asked for a written bound after the current path (No coat rule written, people stay a full shift in the cooler) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host cooler.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on skip cooler scans when the RF fogs, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Coat required. 45-minute max in cooler then a 10-minute out. Wipe RF. Do not skip scans because the screen fogged. I am not restating a hallway yes. skip cooler scans when the RF fogs is out because March 8 four dairy mispicks after fogged screens. Drew timed the wipe at 8 seconds. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: maxmin=45, out=10, wipe=8, miss=4, temp=36.2, weeks=2, coats=12, dairy=4. Sibling tickets PCF-1555 and PCF-SOP-2023-014. I will not reopen skip cooler scans when the RF fogs in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: rf.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (08): refuse on skip cooler scans when the RF fogs, lock is coat, 45/10, wipe RF, no skip. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-1555.
A fogged RF in the cooler is not a reason to skip the scan. It is a reason to wipe it.

What a skeptical lead would try first on cooler.pinecrest.internal: the path Drew Phelps actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
